title: 6 letters, real estate. Can you beat the bot? #shorts
description:
A word puzzle meets Minesweeper. Every letter of the hidden word is a "mine" on the A-Z board: open cells, read the numbers, and guess before the bot does.

6 letters. Category: real estate. Can you beat the bot? Comment your guess before the reveal!

Gojuon Minesweeper - free on the App Store
https://minesweeper.enludus.com

Play with English (A-Z) or Japanese (hiragana) boards, solo vs the bot or with a friend.
